visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A white dog with black spots stands on a patch of grass in an outdoor residential area. (2) A man wearing a green Adidas t-shirt and light shorts approaches a modern glass body composition scale on a wooden deck. (3) He stands on the scale, which shows various body metrics including weight and body fat percentage. (4) The man is seen sitting on the wooden steps, meticulously tying the laces of his white athletic shoes. (5) A young girl in patterned pajamas rides a yellow tricycle on a paved driveway while the man watches. (6) The man performs overhead arm stretches and forward bends to warm up in a semi-covered outdoor area. (7) He proceeds to perform several sets of squats and push-ups on the concrete floor. (8) On a grassy area, he holds a plank position and then performs mountain climbers. (9) The man searches for a kettlebell, finding one that appears heavily rusted near a wooden cabinet. (10) He cleans and then uses the kettlebell for swings and goblet squats in both indoor and outdoor settings. (11) The scene shifts to a bright supermarket where he selects packaged fish, chicken breast, and fresh greens. (12) Back in a modern kitchen, he weighs and slices a raw fish fillet on a wooden cutting board. (13) He boils vegetables and eggs and steams the fish using built-in kitchen appliances. (14) The man sits at a dining table with a spread of healthy food and a glass of iced tea. (15) He eats the meal with chopsticks, showing signs of exhaustion and relief after finishing. (16) A simple two-dimensional animation of a man and woman concludes the video.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A lighthearted acoustic guitar track with a steady piano rhythm begins. A woman's cheerful laughter and the name 'Abao' are heard against a background of natural birdsong. (2) High-pitched 'Ding' sound effects coincide with digital text overlays appearing on screen. The man speaks in an animated, rapid tone about his weight. (3) Rhythmic counting 'One, Two...' by the man is interspersed with audible grunts and heavy breathing during the workout segments. (4) A child's voice enthusiastically cheers 'Jia You' while the tricycle wheels click on the pavement. (5) Metallic thuds and scrapes occur as the man lifts the kettlebell. (6) The acoustic BGM continues smoothly during the transition to the supermarket, where the man's speech becomes calm and informative as he lists food items. (7) Sharp percussive chopping sounds and the hiss of steam dominate the kitchen sequence. (8) Sound of swallowing and clicking of chopsticks against a plate follow, ending with a long, tired exhale by the man.
